stem.text: The graph shows the relationship between stress and strain for three wires of the same linear dimensions but made from different materials.

stem.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled stress and horizontal axis labelled strain, with tick marks at 0.1 and 1.0. Three curves start at the origin, labelled P, Q and R. P is the steepest straight line, Q is a less steep straight line, and R curves and levels off.

items: The extension of P is approximately twice that of Q for the same stress.
The ratio of the Young modulus for P to that of Q is approximately two.
For strain less than 0.1, R obeys Hooke’s law.
